IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: HARNESSING MICRO ENTREPRENEURS TO DELIVER HEALTH EDUCATION AND LIFE-CHANGING PRODUCTS.
IRS990.Desc: THE PROGRAM EMPOWERED 11,429 COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS IN BURKINA FASO, UGANDA AND KENYA WITH TECHNOLOGY AND TRAINING TO DELIVER QUALITY HEALTH SERVICES TO THE DOORSTEPS OF 6,179,910 PEOPLE. THE PROGRAM ASSESSED AND TREATED 3,211,942 CHILDREN WHO COMPRISED OF 461,189 CHILDREN UNDER THE AGE OF ONE AND SUPPORTED 179,685 PREGNANT WOMEN.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: LIVING GOODS IS A TAX-EXEMPT ORGANIZATION UNDER THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, SECTION 501(C)(3) AND RELATED CALIFORNIA CODE SECTIONS. LIVING GOODS UGANDA IS SUBJECT TO UGANDA'S TAX-EXEMPT ORGANIZATION REGULATIONS WHILE LIVING GOODS KENYA IS SUBJECT TO KENYA'S CORPORATE TAX REGULATIONS. LIVING GOODS BURKINA FASO IS TAX-EXEMPT, AND THIS STATUS IS SUPPORTED BY A FORMAL AGREEMENT WITH THE GOVERNMENT AND RELEVENT LINE MINISTRIES, ENSURING FULL COMPLIANCE WITH BURKINABLE LAWS. MANAGEMENT BELIEVES THAT THE IMPACT OF THE UGANDA'S TAX-EXEMPT ORGANIZATION REGULATIONS WILL NOT HAVE ANY SIGNIFICANT IMPACT ON THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. ACCORDINGLY, NO PROVISION FOR INCOME TAXES HAS BEEN REFLECTED IN THESE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS RELATED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S ACTIVITY IN UGANDA OR THE UNITED STATES. MANAGEMENT EVALUATED LIVING GOODS TAX POSITIONS AND CONCLUDED THAT LIVING GOODS HAD MAINTAINED ITS TAX EXEMPT STATUS AND HAD TAKEN NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT REQUIRE ADJUSTMENT TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.

THE ORGANIZATION DISBURSES FUNDS TO ITS SUBSIDIARIES IN KENYA, UGANDA AND BURKINA FASO, ITS BRANCH, AND EACH OF THESE SUBSIDIARIES HAVE MANAGEMENT TEAMS THAT MONITORS UTILIZATION OF THE FUNDS. THE ORGANIZATION PROVIDES CONTROL AND OVERSIGHT FOR THESE SUBSIDIARIES. FUNDS DISBURSED TO THE SUBSIDIARIES IS MONITORED AND REPORTED AS PROGRAM EXPENSES ON SCHEDULE F.
EXPENDITURES ARE RECORDED ON THE ACCRUAL BASIS METHOD OF ACCOUNTING FOR FINANCIAL STATEMENT PURPOSES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ON AN ANNUAL BASIS, THROUGH A SELF-DISCLOSURE FORM, MEMBERS OF THE BOARD, OFFICERS, AND ALL EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE TO THE ORGANIZATION'S BOARD ANY FACTS THAT MAY BE CONSTRUED AS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST WHETHER PERCEIVED, POTENTIAL OR ACTUAL. IF ANY ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS EXISTS, THE BOARD OF A COMMITTEE ASSIGNED BY THE BOARD REVIEWS THE CONFLICT. IF AN ACTUAL CONFLICT ARISES, THE INTERESTED INDIVIDUAL MUST LEAVE DURING DELIBERATIONS AND IS EXLUDED FROM VOTING ON THE RELEVANT ALL CONFLICT OF INTEREST MATTER RELATING TO EMPLOYEES ARE FORMALLY LODGED AND MANAGED BY THE SENIOR COMPLIANCE OFFICER. ALL ACTUAL, PERCEIVED OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS ARE MANAGED THROUGH ESTABLISHED ACCOUNTABILITY MECHANISMS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15B:
